title: cookr Repo Config
description: Schema for .cookr.json (format 2), committed at a repo's root. Its presence opts the repo into cookr. It holds only what the cookbook does not: where the cookbook is, the cookbooks it links into, and the code roots every file of which must be covered by some artifact's implementations. A cookbook with no code of its own, like this repo's, needs none.

cookbook.description: The cookbook directory, relative to the repo root

dependencies.description: Cookbooks this one links into, keyed by cookbook UUID

rdid.description: Cached readable name; cookr refreshes it

location.description: Repo-relative path to the dependency's cookbook directory (a submodule, normally, or a sibling checkout such as ../other/cookbook), or a URL, which is never read. An absolute path is refused: a path on one machine belongs in ~/.cookr/locations.json. Absent: look it up in ~/.cookr/locations.json

path.description: Source directory, relative to the repo root

group.description: The cookbook folder this root's recipes belong in

ignore.description: Globs excluded from this root's coverage
Root-relative or repo-relative globs excluded from coverage
